title: After application startup loop fails with "Pump not initialized!" until manual connection to pump initiated
symptom: Whenever AAPS is (re)started, loop is not functional, failing with "Pump not initialized!" error, until manual connection to pump is initiated. It may be hours in this state before a manual connection will be made, after which everything works.
cause: The primary reason is that the pump disconnects unexpectedly, which is an error state.
fix: AAPS can recover from this state now better after a commit (1d6a48d01dcd16a5767940f9e04e3003af60e713) in dev; after a few minutes it connects to pump and succeeds with dosing changes without manual intervention.
evidence_quote: primary reason is that pump disconnects unexpectly which is an error state. AAPS can recover from this state now better
